events.name: Bash
events.head: Check related task states and key commit

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate key-shaped text in commit without printing it fully
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git show --stat 746afc0e | tail -5; git show 746afc0e | grep -oE "[A-Za-z_]*(key|Key)[^\"]{0,20}[\"' :=]+[A-Za-z0-9_-]{4}" | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find key token shape (masked)
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git show 746afc0e -- workshop-plan/tasks/inbox.jsonl | grep '^+' | grep -i "F-07260b02\|api key\|tantra key" | grep -oE "\b[A-Za-z]{2,8}[_-][A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}\b" | sed -E 's/^(.{6}).*(.{3})$/\1...\2 len/' | sort -u | head;

events.name: Bash
events.head: Verify mirror history no longer contains the key, then delete temp files
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; umask 077; K=$(mktemp); git show 746afc0e -- workshop-plan/tasks/inbox.jsonl | grep '^+' | grep -oE "\bntk_li[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}\b" | sort -u > $K; wc -l < $K
